user.title: Connect GetMyMeter
user.description: Open getMyMeter, then Developer Tools → Network. Click Daily or Monthly and select the `/ami_data` request. Copy the query values and the Request Headers `h2o-token` into the matching fields. Do not use cookies, the page token, Copy as cURL, or a HAR file.

data_description.account: From the `/ami_data` query string. Copy the full `l` value, including any suffix after the hyphen. This is not your email or password.
data_description.token: From Request Headers on that same `/ami_data` request. Paste the complete value, including the `<token>` and `</token>` wrappers. A 36-character UUID from `H2O-Portal-Token` or the `h2o-portal-token` cookie will be rejected.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate GetMyMeter
reauth_confirm.description: The previous `h2o-token` expired. Generate a fresh `/ami_data` request and paste the Request Headers `h2o-token` value, including `<token>` and `</token>`. Do not use the page token or cookie.

data_description.token: Paste the complete `/ami_data` Request Headers `h2o-token` value, including `<token>` and `</token>`. A 36-character UUID from the portal page or cookie will be rejected.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GetMyMeter
reconfigure.description: Change the meter identity using a current `/ami_data` request. Paste a fresh `h2o-token` header, including `<token>` and `</token>`, to validate the new values.

data_description.account: From the `/ami_data` query string. Copy the full `l` value, including any suffix after the hyphen.
data_description.token: From Request Headers on that same `/ami_data` request. Include `<token>` and `</token>`. Do not use the page token or cookie.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the GetMyMeter portal. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: That token was rejected. Use the `/ami_data` Request Headers `h2o-token` value, including `<token>` and `</token>`. Do not use the 36-character page token or cookie.

abort.already_configured: This GetMyMeter meter channel is already configured.

reauth_required.message: The GetMyMeter portal token has expired or was rejected; reauthentication is required.
